## Self-review checklist

- [ ] I opened the preview deployment and actually looked at it
- [ ] Checked at mobile width as well as desktop
- [ ] Both locales still read correctly (`/` and `/ja/`)
- [ ] No leftover placeholder copy, `TODO`s, or commented-out markup
- [ ] Links work and point somewhere real
- [ ] No secrets, API keys, or personal data in the diff
- [ ] The change is scoped to one thing
